rss: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over next two years
title: Toy Car Makers Face Tough Roads
story: Toy car makers are having a tough time because new electric toys and foreign competition. They plan to make changes to keep up.
storyBig: The toy car industry is facing challenges due to a shift towards electric models and increased global competition. Companies are strategizing to adapt to these changes and maintain market share.
think: What might happen if toy companies don't adapt to new trends?
bull: New electric toys are exciting and environmentally friendly!
bear: Struggling toy car makers may need more time to adapt.

rss: More funding needed to boost construction jobs for young people, housing boss says
title: Builders Need More Kids to Help
story: Builder companies need more kids to help build houses and treehouses. They want to teach kids how to build cool stuff.
storyBig: The construction industry is experiencing a labor shortage, necessitating the recruitment of younger workers to meet housing demands. Companies are advocating for more educational programs to train future builders.
think: Why is it important to have enough workers in construction?
bull: Learning to build can be a fun and rewarding career!
bear: Without enough builders, building projects might slow down.
